text: The Government of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, the oblast's permanently operating highest executive body of state power, is listed on HC Torpedo's own partner feed as a title partner.
short: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast government is a Torpedo title partner

source.name: Government of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (nobl.ru): main page
source.note: The oblast government's official portal (Russian). Undated; footer says © 2002—2026. English: 'The Government of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast is the permanently operating highest executive body of state power of the oblast.'
source.quote: Правительство Нижегородской области является постоянно действующим высшим исполнительным органом государственной власти области.
